page.content:
Core policy that articles should fairly represent published views.

How Neutral point of view connects

  • Topic: Five pillars — Neutral point of view is the first of the Five pillars.
  • Item: Talk page — NPOV disputes are argued on talk pages before they reach administrators.

What is Neutral point of view?

Neutral point of view (NPOV) is the pillar that forbids advocacy pages. Editors are expected to describe disputes rather than join them, with weight matching reliable sources.

Key threads lead to Five pillars and Talk page.
